title: Production delivery: frequent validated main releases
description:
## Intent

Promote green, reviewed work to main frequently and automatically deliver validated static-site revisions without a coding agent using personal AWS credentials.

## Delivered static-site automation (2026-10-10)

- Main revision 1fb623a07670357e4e8124b20f6fdab67848ed41 was promoted by PR #18.
- GitHub Actions run https://github.com/AnthusAI/Sierrendipity/actions/runs/38065921757 passed all required tests plus GitHub OIDC, exact web build publish, CloudFront invalidation, and live provenance verification.
- https://sierrendipity.anth.us/deployment.json publicly serves the same main SHA.

## Current scope

- Validated pushes to main automatically deploy static website content only.
- The workflow uses the narrow GitHub OIDC role and does not store long-lived AWS credentials.
- Backend, runner, and broader CDK/infrastructure deployments remain human-operated and need separate approval and planning.

## Guardrails

Do not broaden the delivery role, create persistent credentials, change branch protections, or automate backend/runner/infrastructure delivery without explicit action-time authorization.
